key_terms: A package that exposes an engine's native implementation to another language. Ballista's Python package wraps supported behavior and does not make arbitrary Python callbacks serializable.
The Ballista and DataFusion crates whose types and execution contracts the Python binding wraps. A Rust client needs its own prepared Cargo project and dependency lock.
The requirement that client, scheduler and executors agree on release and dependency versions, here Ballista 54.1.0 with DataFusion 54 from one image.
A DataFrame or SQL call that only builds a plan until an action such as collect submits it to the scheduler for execution.
evidence: Project-only actual product commands with independent fixture oracles. Source preparation, native runtime observations and restart evidence are recorded separately in the workshop qualification ledger.
